messages:
marta: heads up — saw a batch of embeddings requests get accepted after a key rotation. these requests were scoped to /models/embed-ld but the rotated key should have been allowlisted only for /models/chat. looks like per-route enforcement missed these during the rollout :thinking_face:

sam: can you paste the request header & audit id? might be a scope-mapping issue or a cache TTL problem on the authz side.

marta: audit id: 224800-ev-71. sample header:
```
Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-REDACTED
X-Route: /models/embed-ld
X-Request-ID: 224800-ev-71
```
server log snippet shows: `scope_check: allow (route: /models/embed-ld) reason: token.route_cache_hit`

jordan: hmm. we changed the per-route allowlist metadata shape in the RBAC refactor last week (route_patterns -> route_allowlist). TTL for the cache is still 5m, but the metadata key stored by KMS rewrap includes the old field name — maybe the cache proxy is doing a permissive fallback when it can't find route_allowlist.

sam: that fallback would explain it. fallback rule was added to avoid 5xx during metadata migration. it returns allow if metadata lookup fails and the token is otherwise valid. i thought we gated that behind a feature flag. @devops-bot any recent feature-flag toggles?

devops-bot: feature-flag "rbac-metadata-strict" toggled -> OFF by deploy 224800-deploy-9 (~2248001200) (user: deploy-service).

marta: deploy timeline matches. rotation happened at 2248001100, then the RBAC migration deploy at 2248001200 that disabled the strict check. so rotated keys rewrapped with new KMS tag name but the proxy code expected the old tag and fell into permissive fallback.

auditsvc: audit log entries for 224800-ev-71: 
- 2248001105 authn: key-rotate success key_id=kms-wrap-42
- 2248001130 authz: metadata-fetch route_allowlist lookup -> NOT FOUND (old_tag found=route_patterns)
- 2248001131 authz: fallback-permissive allow user=svc-analytics route=/models/embed-ld

jordan: proposed immediate steps:
1) re-enable "rbac-metadata-strict" to force deny-on-missing (hotfix).
2) backfill metadata translator: copy route_patterns -> route_allowlist tag for any keys rotated in last 24h.
3) add a short-term audit alert for any allow decisions that cite "fallback-permissive".

sam: +1. also open a postmortem ticket and mark as P1 for external risk — embeddings could expose vector-store indices depending on tenant. i'll take the hotfix.

marta: hotfix deployed (2248003600). auditors: i've kicked off the translator job to backfill keys. opened ticket: ENGSEC-1429. adding a log filter to surface all fallback-permissive allows from 2248001000..2248004800.

jordan: once backfill completes, we should run a scan for keys rotated in that window and force revalidation (revoke & reissue) for any that still show route_patterns-only metadata. also add a unit test to prevent permissive fallback without explicit flag.

sam: noted. thanks all. filing brief incident note for compliance: "temporary permissive authz fallback allowed some embeddings requests post-rotation; mitigated by re-enabling strict RBAC and metadata backfill" :white_check_mark:

marta: adding to audit log with remediation steps and tagging security:incident. closing the thread after the postmortem is drafted.
